hypothesis: Possession-context nuisance controls can improve the next-season generalization of five-year zero-prior RAPM player ratings without using future data.

context_definitions.score_state: Score margin before the current possession, reconstructed only from earlier possessions in the same game.
context_definitions.quarter_progress: One-indexed possession rank divided by possession count within game and period.
context_definitions.garbage_filter: Drop training rows when absolute pre-possession home margin is at least base(period)+8*(1-quarter_progress), with bases 25,20,17,12 for Q1,Q2,Q3,Q4+.
context_definitions.quarter_rubberband: Four scale-standardized columns: offense score margin before possession interacted with Q1,Q2,Q3,Q4+.
context_definitions.clock_fatigue: Legacy replication proxy clipped to [0,1]: 0.8*(min(period,4)-1)/3 + 0.2*quarter_progress. This is clock state, not observed player fatigue.

evaluation.primary: next-season game-margin prediction using frozen player coefficients and the home coefficient only
evaluation.secondary: conditional next-season game-margin retrodiction including context columns; not a pregame forecast
evaluation.selection_rule: maximize equal-season primary correlation; within 0.0005 choose lower primary RMSE

restrictions: No time decay is tested in this experiment.
No context field enters the public RAPM without a separate promotion review.
Rubberband conditional scores cannot be interpreted as pregame prediction because live margin is not known before the game.
forbidden_interpretation: This is reused development evidence for a local research challenger, not untouched confirmation, causal effort adjustment, or a public-model promotion.
